common.footer_reason: You are receiving this email because of your notification settings in LLMAIx Web.
common.footer_admin_reason: You are receiving this email because you are an administrator of this LLMAIx Web instance.

preprocessing.completed: All {total} file(s) in the project "{project}" were preprocessed successfully.
preprocessing.partial: {processed} of {total} file(s) in the project "{project}" were preprocessed. {failed} failed.
preprocessing.failed: Preprocessing of {total} file(s) in the project "{project}" failed.

trial.completed: The extraction run "{run}" in the project "{project}" finished. {succeeded} of {total} document(s) were extracted.
trial.partial: The extraction run "{run}" in the project "{project}" finished. {succeeded} of {total} document(s) were extracted, {failed} failed.
trial.failed: The extraction run "{run}" in the project "{project}" failed.

hint.failed: Open the run to see the per-item error messages, and retry the failed items once the cause is fixed.

heading.granted: A project was shared with you

intro.granted: {actor} gave you {permission} access to the project "{project}".
intro.updated: {actor} changed your access to the project "{project}" to {permission}.

subject.password_reset_by_admin: Your password was reset by an administrator
subject.identity_linked: A new sign-in method was added to your account
subject.identity_unlinked: A sign-in method was removed from your account

intro.password_changed: The password for your LLMAIx Web account was just changed.
intro.password_reset_by_admin: An administrator set a new password for your LLMAIx Web account. You will need it the next time you sign in.
intro.account_locked: Your LLMAIx Web account was locked for {minutes} minute(s) after {attempts} failed sign-in attempts.
intro.identity_linked: Your LLMAIx Web account can now sign in with {provider}.
intro.identity_unlinked: {provider} can no longer be used to sign in to your LLMAIx Web account.

note.contact_admin: If you did not do this, contact your administrator immediately — someone else may have access to your account.
note.locked_hint: Access is restored automatically once the lock expires. If it was not you, change your password as soon as you can sign in again.

subject.worker_crash: LLMAIx Web: a background task crashed
subject.stuck_tasks: LLMAIx Web: stuck background tasks were reclaimed

intro.worker_crash: A Celery worker died while running a task, so the affected job was marked as failed. This usually means the worker process ran out of memory or was killed.
intro.stuck_tasks: The periodic sweeper found {count} task(s) that stopped reporting progress and marked them as failed so they no longer block the queue.
intro.error_spike: The server returned an unhandled error. The full stack trace is in the error log under the ID below.

note.cooldown: Further alerts of this kind are suppressed for {minutes} minute(s) to avoid a flood.

test.heading: Your SMTP settings work
test.intro: This is a test email sent from the LLMAIx Web admin settings. If you received it, notification email is configured correctly.
